Every mutating Writer mission must start from an exact Controller-bound `main` commit and work on one mission-specific candidate branch. decision: The long-lived CEP GitHub Writer repository is the self-contained execution-input plane for ALL CEP Writer types and equivalent mission Auditors/Reviewers. Before every mission, the Controller—not the worker—must resolve live CEP authority and compile a minimum-sufficient CLOSED/MANDATORY READ SET: exact repository/source/test/reference/profile/oracle/Owner-decision paths (or exact sections/symbols where full-file reading is unnecessary), each input's purpose/read mode, exact writable/read-only/prohibited scope, and explicit DO_NOT_READ / NO_DISCOVERY_BY_DEFAULT boundaries. Broad repository archaeology, repo-wide recursive search, generic grep/rg/find, or instructions such as 'inspect anything useful' are prohibited by default because they waste model context and can import stale/unrelated authority. A BOUNDED_DISCOVERY_ESCAPE is allowed only for a named missing, contradictory, or insufficient mission input and must stay within the smallest relevant directory/source family and record why it was needed. `main` must carry the current Controller-bound Product baseline plus every reusable/current Writer-readable input a competent worker needs: build/test tooling, contracts/profiles, current governed visual references, applicable domain/oracle/technical references, Writer-relevant Owner-decision snapshots, protected-truth/acceptance rules, workflow guidance, and genuinely required deterministic fixtures/reference datasets. A mission branch/workspace inherits those inputs and adds only the exact immutable mission overlay plus task-specific inputs not already present. Required reference images/PDFs/fixtures are INPUTS and remain available even when relatively large; do not remove them merely to minimize repository size. Writer execution must not depend on live Google Drive lookup for required task inputs. The Controller must retrieve/resolve any Drive-only authority/evidence/profile/oracle input before launch and embed or deterministically project the sufficient authoritative content into the repository, mission overlay, capsule, or bound workspace with provenance/hash/classification. CHATGPT_WRITER may possess a Drive connector, but required mission inputs are still pre-resolved and self-contained; live Drive is for Controller authority reconstruction, bounded explicitly-authorized retrieval, and output custody—not worker-side broad archaeology. GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_WRITER and ROUTE-LOCAL workers must not be instructed to read required inputs directly from Drive. ROUTE-LOCAL additionally uses the already materialized governed local repository/worktree as its execution source: do not clone/pull/fetch from GitHub at the start of every mission. Bind the exact local repository path/branch/HEAD/tree and continue from it; clone/fetch/pull occurs only when the Owner/Controller explicitly authorizes a transport synchronization because the required checkpoint is absent/stale or a carrier transition requires it. Google Drive remains canonical for live Controller state/governance and heavy GENERATED OUTPUT custody such as candidate/evidence/baseline ZIPs, large screenshot sets, videos and generated reports. Small handoff/results/receipts may bind external Drive outputs by file ID, SHA-256, bytes and source/commit identity. Before launch, Controller must prove MISSION REQUIRED INPUT SET -> EXACT PATH/SECTION RESOLUTION -> HASH/CLASSIFICATION MATCH -> CONTEXT-SUFFICIENT CLOSED READ SET -> NO REQUIRED DRIVE-ONLY DEPENDENCY -> WRITER_SELF_CONTAINMENT_PASS. If any required input is missing/stale/unresolved, launch stops as WRITER_INPUT_INCOMPLETE.
notes: Owner explicitly required the former local-only prompt/read-set extension to be merged into this same durable decision instead of remaining a separate active OD. OD-20260925-084 is preserved only as superseded lineage. The generalized law applies to all Writer types; route-specific facts remain scoped: Local and Google AI Studio do not directly consume required Drive inputs, and Local normally continues from its existing governed local repository rather than cloning/pulling every mission.

decision: For CEP Writer/Controller visual work, browser/network/localhost navigation failure must be treated separately from browser launch, rendering, JavaScript/DOM execution, pointer/keyboard interaction, screenshot creation/inspection, video capture/validation, and genuine route/platform proof. Every material screenshot must be actually opened and visually inspected; material video must be structurally validated and representative states/transitions inspected where applicable. decision: For CEP Writers, especially CHATGPT_WRITER, the primary work loop is local execution and iterative Product improvement, not external evidence transport. Intermediate screenshots, crops, visual diffs, videos, logs, build outputs and comparison artifacts are execution scratch and remain local/ephemeral by default. Their first purpose is to help the Writer discover defects, compare current Product state against the governed reference component-by-component/state-by-state, implement the narrowest correct change, then rerender/recapture/reinspect until the result is clean. Only the final representative source-bound captures/results that materially support handoff/audit are promoted to durable evidence. The GitHub connector MUST NOT be used as a bulk-file, screenshot/video, per-file blob-assembly or general evidence-transfer channel when local execution plus bounded final custody suffices. GitHub carries Product source/delta, mission-bound authority inputs, and small receipts/handoffs; ChatGPT heavy generated outputs and candidate/evidence bundles go to Google Drive in one bounded final custody step when needed. Google AI Studio may use its governed candidate-branch evidence exception only because Drive output is unavailable there, and still should avoid intermediate evidence churn. Connector/tool limits are transport constraints, never a reason to spend the Writer's main effort on packaging, split uploads or repeated custody operations, and never a reason to change Product architecture. Prefer reference decomposition/cropping -> current capture -> region/state comparison -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture -> compare -> repeat, with final evidence promotion only after the Writer has used the loop to improve the Product.
notes: Owner explicitly rejected time spent on connector/file-transfer mechanics and clarified that Writer screenshots/evidence primarily exist to drive the Writer's own correction loop. This clarifies and tightens OD-067, OD-068 and OD-072 without changing Product authority, branch lineage or acceptance requirements.
